evidenceBoundary: Static checked-source demand and generated artifacts only. Generated consumers are not individual operation runtime passes. Retained optimized link bytes, initialization traces, OS input and accessibility require their own results.

representation.provenDataCallables: typed Rc<dyn Fn>; one stable Value callable bridge at dynamic/public boundaries
representation.templates: NativeSnapshot and native GPUI factories; no Value::Template paint interpreter
representation.strings: lossless Value boundary; UTF-16 comparisons include caught code units
representation.ordinaryRecordsAndArrays: identity-preserving Value storage remains; complete per-field native lowering is not established
representation.support: shared content-bound SDK source; reached operation/callback pruning controls call sites and capability initialization; full helper source selection and optimized link cost are not certified
